title: College Football
description:
Indiana at Michigan
No. 6 Indiana (6-1) visits Michigan (4-2) at Michigan Stadium in a Big Ten matchup. Michigan beat Penn State 21-18 and looks to quarterback Bryce Underwood, while Indiana fell 19-15 to Ohio State and relies on Josh Hoover, who has 18 TDs this season.

title: College Football
description:
BYU at UCF
The No. 2 BYU Cougars visit the UCF Knights for a Big 12 game. The BYU Cougars remain undefeated after beating the Notre Dame Fighting Irish, 28-24, led by Bear Bachmeier's 224 passing yards, while UCF fell to Oklahoma State, 42-28.
